responsibility: Implements Renesas RX common option validation and machine-state adjustment. It checks numeric ranges for RX-specific tuning options, forces no-FPU mode when low-end CPUs such as RX100/RX200 are selected, emits diagnostics if FPU use is requested on CPUs without hardware support, selects SJLJ unwinding, and exports the RX common hook table that supplies normalized target flag state to the backend.
